metaTitle: Say Goodbye to Excess Fat | Victory Medical Services & Medical Spa
metaDescription: CoolSculpting® is a non-invasive, non-surgical body contouring procedure that offers targeted fat reduction of problem areas on your body.

blocks.html: CoolSculpting® is a non-invasive, non-surgical body contouring procedure that offers targeted fat reduction of problem areas on your body. CoolSculpting® safely targets fat cells without damaging your skin, resulting in a 20-25% reduction in the desired area.

CoolSculpting® is not surgery. It is unlike any other treatment you have ever tried as it is an innovative treatment that helps freeze stubborn fat for the long term. No surgery required. No needles involved. No downtime. Many people have the treatment performed during their lunch break.

CoolSculpting® can treat many areas of the body and can target exercise and diet-resistant fat cells. For best results, some patients require multiple treatments. If you can pinch it, CoolSculpting® can reduce it!

blocks.text: What is the Cost of CoolSculpting®?

blocks.html: The total cost of CoolSculpting® depends on how many areas are treated, the number of treatments you need, and the areas you are targeting. We sometimes have promotional deals, so ask when you call our office for your FREE consultation.

The goal of both CoolSculpting® and liposuction is to eliminate unwanted deposits of fat from the body. These treatments are very different from one another though. Liposuction involves making incisions in the skin which sometimes result in a scar and require a certain amount of recovery time. CoolSculpting® is a non-invasive treatment that uses an innovative cooling technique to reduce the amount of fat on the body without the need for downtime.
